fieldValues.title: How is a cluster's quality judged without affirmation?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: No option chosen. Raised as an open question in Research (5. What AI should own: clusters and other dynamic structure), 2026-10-30, and turned into an exercise so options are explored before any decision.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. Stability: the same clusters across runs.
- B. Coverage and cohesion: every problem placed, each cluster coherent.
- C. The owner reads the result now and then.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Which measure agrees with the owner's judgement on a sample.
fieldValues.next_action: Score two synthesiser runs both ways and ask the owner which clusters read better.
